description: TICON provides harmonic constants for forty tidal constituents at 1,145 tide gauges distributed around the world. The research team derives amplitudes, phases and uncertainty measures from GESLA-2 sea-level series, retaining records longer than one year with at least seventy percent valid observations. PANGAEA repository distributes a tab-separated ASCII table in a ZIP archive under CC BY 4.0 for free reuse. Fields include coordinates, observation dates, missingness and maximum gaps, supporting selective tide-model validation before coastal infrastructure simulations. Coverage varies among gauges, and harmonic constants do not represent all storm-surge or long-term sea-level behaviour. Users can select individual constituents for comparison. No directly related catalogue record was identified.
